video_title: Devin Booker Postgame On-Court Interview after Suns win against Orlando Magic | 11-5-26

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the Suns' recent performance and team mindset
quotes.excerpt: We came in with the right mindset. We've been turning in the right way.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Back-to-back 30 pieces for you. You have the hot hand against tonight's win in the first half. How were you able to get it going early?

text_blocks.speaker: Devin Booker
text_blocks.text: Just feeding off the energy from yesterday, trying to get a much-needed win. We came in with the right mindset. We've been turning in the right way. They haven't converted into wins yet, but getting a win today was special.

quotes.social_post: Devin Booker says the Suns are feeding off the energy from yesterday to get a much needed win. He notes the team is turning in the right direction despite the recent struggles to convert efforts into wins.

structured.context: Devin Booker discusses the team mindset and their recent win against the Orlando Magic during an on-court postgame interview.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the Suns' progress toward a complete game
quotes.excerpt: I think this is the closest to a complete game that we played.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You also mentioned this team needing to put together a full 48. You guys have done it in spurts, not yet, but how close do you feel you were to that tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Devin Booker
text_blocks.text: I think this is the closest to a complete game that we played. We've had bright spots in the last game, we just want to keep it for a whole entire game. So something to build on, still a lot of work to do. We have a homestand right now that we're trying to take advantage of.

quotes.social_post: Devin Booker believes tonight was the closest the Suns have come to playing a complete 48 minute game. He says the team has bright spots to build on during their current homestand.

structured.context: Devin Booker reflects on the team's progress toward playing a complete 48-minute game following their victory.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker praises Miles Bridges' versatility and rebounding
quotes.excerpt: Taking on the challenge of guarding Franz, hitting stepback threes, getting boards.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Speaking of bright spots, the bench was great for you guys, 37 points, but this guy right here, Miles Bridges, what was he able to give you?

text_blocks.speaker: Devin Booker
text_blocks.text: I mean, just the versatility. Taking on the challenge of guarding Franz, hitting stepback threes, getting boards. He got like 11, 12 boards today, so obviously a department that we've been lacking in and we've been needing it.

quotes.social_post: Devin Booker praised Miles Bridges for his versatility against Orlando. Booker highlighted Bridges' ability to guard Franz Wagner and his impact on the glass, noting that rebounding is a department the team has been lacking in.

structured.context: Devin Booker praises Miles Bridges for his versatile performance and rebounding effort in the win against the Orlando Magic.
